en.headline: Police arrest domestic helper over death of 93-year-old woman in Kai Tak
en.dek: Officers say closed-circuit footage shows the helper striking the elderly woman multiple times before seeking help on Sunday.
body: Hong Kong police have arrested a 52-year-old Indonesian domestic helper on suspicion of murder after a 93-year-old woman she cared for was found unresponsive in a public housing flat at Tak Long Estate in Kai Tak on Sunday.

The elderly woman, surnamed Kwan, was taken to hospital after the helper sought assistance from building security staff at about 8.20am on Sunday and was pronounced dead at 9.12am. Police later reviewed closed-circuit television footage from inside the flat.

Acting Senior Superintendent Wan King-hang of Sau Mau Ping District said the footage showed the helper striking the woman’s head, neck and face with her bare hands more than 20 times and stamping on her abdomen while moving her, during a period shortly before she sought help. Officers also found footage indicating intermittent assaults over the previous half-month.

Police said preliminary forensic examination noted contusions and abrasions but no immediately fatal injuries, and an autopsy will determine the cause of death. The helper was arrested in the early hours of Monday and remains in custody. Officers said the relationship had deteriorated amid long-term caregiving friction.
The case is being handled by the Sau Mau Ping District crime squad. Police appealed for anyone with information to contact them.

zh.headline: 啟德德朗邨九旬婦身亡 外傭涉謀殺被捕
zh.dek: 警方指閉路電視顯示外傭周日早上多次擊打老婦頭頸面部，其後求助，老婦送院不治。
body: 香港警方已拘捕一名52歲印尼籍外籍家庭傭工，涉嫌謀殺她所照顧的93歲老婦。老婦周日早上在啟德德朗邨公屋單位內失去知覺，送院後證實不治。
警方秀茂坪警區署理高級警司溫景亨表示，老婦姓關，獨居於德朗邨德瑤樓約150平方呎單位。外傭於周日早上約8時20分向大廈保安求助，指老婦沒有反應，救護員到場後送院，老婦於上午9時12分證實死亡。
警方檢取單位內閉路電視片段後發現，外傭在求助前約七分鐘內，間斷地以徒手擊打老婦頸部、頭部及面部約20次，並用腳踩其腹部移動身體。片段亦顯示過去半個月內，外傭每天都有間歇性施襲情況。
警方初步法醫檢查發現死者身上有多處瘀傷及擦傷，但未見即時致命傷勢，死因有待解剖確定。外傭於周一凌晨被拘捕，現正扣查。警方相信因長期照顧關係出現磨擦，導致雙方關係不良。
案件由秀茂坪警區重案組跟進。警方呼籲市民如有資料可聯絡調查人員。
